title: Make a review set from missed cards
intro: These are the cards your class missed in this assignment, most missed first. Pick the ones to keep and they are saved as a new set. The original set and assignment stay as they are.
rewriteHint: Fronts and meanings stay; only the example sentences change to new ones. You can edit them before assigning.
rewriteWordsOnly: New examples work for word sets only.
saveFailed: Could not save the set. Please try again.
aiFailed: Could not write AI examples. You can make the set with the old examples.
done: The review set is ready. Open it to check the cards and assign it to the class.
